searchText: I was thinking about interactions between accumulators and epoch-based state eviction. An option: the current epoch's state is merkleized, and old epochs are verkleized once they become read-only. Some advantages: - smaller witnesses for old epochs (if we optimize verkle trees for read-only) - no complexity or slowdown with updating verkle trees Some disadvantages: - larger witnesses for the current epoch - huge verkle-root calculation, difficult to debug - complexity of two accumulators Or, more generally, more convenient dynamic accumulator for active state and static accumulator for inactive state.
